name: uniquedomains-nodejs
description: Node SDK, CLI and use-case packages for the Unique Domains API.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/sdk && npm run build --workspace packages/cli --workspace packages/whois --workspace packages/domain-availability --workspace packages/registrar-prices --workspace packages/domain-appraisal
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/sdk --noEmit && tsc -p packages/sdk/typetests && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p packages/whois --noEmit && tsc -p packages/domain-availability --noEmit && tsc -p packages/registrar-prices --noEmit && tsc -p packages/domain-appraisal --noEmit && tsc -p test/typetests
